# Style

<!-- generated by `kit scan` · inputs: **/*.cs (excluding migrations and generated files) · do not edit: decisions go in .claude/decisions/ -->

| fact                                | value |
| ----------------------------------- | ----- |
| file-scoped namespaces              | all |
| usings outside the namespace        | all |
| open brace on its own line (Allman) | all |
| private fields named _camelCase     | most |
| var for locals                      | most |
| target-typed new()                  | yes |
| expression-bodied members (=>)      | yes |
| #region blocks in classes           | few |
| region names                        | Commands, Constructor, Events, Methods, Observables, Private members |
| XML doc comments on interfaces      | some |
| XML doc comments on classes         | none |
| comment language                    | mixed Hungarian and English |
| Task-returning methods end in Async | all |
| one top-level type per file         | most |
| file name equals the type name      | all |
| #nullable directives in files       | yes |
| #pragma warning disable             | yes |
| null! initializers                  | yes |
| records                             | no |
| UTF-8 BOM                           | most |

## Notes

- Some files change nullable context or silence warnings locally; see `kit evidence style` for which.
